understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked '+' in each level and ultimately win the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: MOVE_LEFT and MOVE_RIGHT shift the player horizontally, while gravity causes vertical movement. Movement may carry the player along a column until blocked. CLICK targets removable clickable tiles and consumes a turn, without directly moving the player. Spike tiles are hazards that end the attempt upon landing. Each level provides two attempts with up to 50 turns; a failed attempt restarts the level and records the failure. Undo was not observed in the recent actions.
